_comment: Machine-readable grading rubric. verdict.py computes the verdict from this file - the Evaluator never picks the verdict itself. Documented in SKILL.md next to this file. PROTECTED.

checks.title: import-linter contracts all KEPT (repository encapsulation, event-bus-only consumers, layers)
Error contract: zero built-in / HTTPException raises in service or routes layers
Every EMIT/HANDLE event in the sprint contract is defined, published and subscribed
No protected file changed unless the contract approves it
Cross-module side effects are raised with bus.publish(<DomainEvent>) - no other module's service is called to write, notify or report
Routes only parse/auth/delegate/map; repositories only store/query; business rules live in the service
reports performs no write on activities/programmes/staff (reads go through reader Protocols only)
Correct AppError subclass and domain error code per failure (cross-store = 404, permission = 403, rule violation = 409/422)
New services/subscribers wired only in app.py; cross-module reads use a <Name>Reader Protocol exported from the package
Full pytest suite passes
Coverage: service >= 80%, routes >= 70%, core >= 60%, overall >= 70%
Every changed source file meets its own layer threshold
No changed test function asserts only on status_code
Every AC id in the sprint contract is referenced by at least one test
Each AC's THEN clause is asserted on business state (body fields, follow-up GET, alerts/metrics, events) - not just the status code
Negative paths tested: missing auth, other-store isolation, validation, permission, partial failure where the contract requires it
generator-summary.md AC self-check and layer table match the code (no false PASS claims)
Implementation matches contract scope: every AC implemented, nothing unrequested added
ruff check . passes (includes TID251 HTTPException ban)
ruff format --check . passes
mypy --strict (pyproject config) passes
StoreOps conventions: schemas extra=forbid, *Create/*Update/*Out naming, StrEnum lowercase values, SCREAMING_SNAKE domain error codes, store scoping on every query
Repository = Protocol + InMemory implementation; service depends on the Protocol
No dead code, print(), TODO without a known-gap entry, or commented-out code
